fullDescription: WinTalent style guide for enterprise talent assessment reports, featuring a tech-focused professional aesthetic. Characterized by a clean 'tech-blue' palette, high-end editorial typography using Plus Jakarta Sans, and structured data visualization. Suitable for HR tech, recruitment SaaS, corporate evaluation dashboards, and data-heavy professional reports. Includes details for PDF-friendly printing, bento-style cards, and refined grid layouts.

structured.summary: A professional assessment report interface featuring a permanent sidebar for context, a sticky utility header, and a centered 'paper-style' report container. The design uses a white/slate background with blue accents to denote authority and precision, emphasizing readability and data-driven insights through radar charts and structured recommendation cards.

style.description: The style is 'Enterprise Modern' utilizing a dual-font system: Plus Jakarta Sans for UI/copy and JetBrains Mono for data/IDs. The color palette is built on #2563EB (Tech Blue) and #0F172A (Slate Dark), with soft backgrounds of #F8FAFC. Micro-interactions include hover scales and subtle shadow transitions. The design features a specific 16px/24px border radius logic and an 8% opacity soft shadow system.
style.prompt:
### Visual Design System
- **Color Palette**: 
  - Primary: #2563EB (Blue 600) for actions/headers, #1E3A8A (Blue 900) for deep accents.
  - Backgrounds: #F8FAFC (Slate 50) for body, #FFFFFF (White) for cards.
  - Feedback: #16A34A (Green 600) for strengths, #D97706 (Amber 600) for risks.
  - Borders: #E2E8F0 (Slate 200).
- **Typography**: 
  - Body: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif. Weights: 400 (Regular), 600 (Semibold), 800 (ExtraBold).
  - Data/Monospace: 'JetBrains Mono'. Use for score displays and IDs.
  - Headings: 3xl (30px) for names, lg (18px) for section titles, text-[10px] for uppercase metadata labels.
- **Shadows & Borders**:
  - Default Card: `box-shadow: 0 10px 40px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);`, border: 1px solid #F1F5F9.
  - Score Badge: `shadow-xl shadow-blue-200/50`.
- **Animation Settings**: 
  - Transitions: 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1).
  - Hover state: scale(1.05) on floating buttons.

layout_and_structure.description: A 3-tier layout: Left sidebar (288px), sticky top header (64px), and a scrollable main area containing a fixed-width (960px) report card.

prompts.prompt: Width 288px (w-72), background #FFFFFF with right border #E2E8F0. Top section contains brand logo and a 2nd-line meta-caption in text-[10px] tracking-widest. Nav items have 12px gap, 10px padding, and use 18px icons. Active state: #EFF6FF background and #2563EB text. Bottom includes a status card with #EFF6FF background and blue-800 text for system alerts.

The top of the 960px card. Left side features a 80x80px avatar with 16px radius and 4px white border. 24px gap between avatar and text. Candidate name in 30px Extrabold. Below, a 3-column grid for metadata (Date, Duration, Interviewer) with labels in 10px bold uppercase Slate-400. Right side features a Score Badge: 40px mono-text score inside a #2563EB rounded-2xl container.

2-column grid. Left column: 240px SVG Radar chart with a hexagon grid (#E2E8F0) and data area filled with rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.2) and a 2px blue stroke. Labels are positioned absolutely around the SVG. Right column: Strengths and Weaknesses lists. Each list item has a 10px gap between a 16px icon and text. Vertical gap between list items is 10px (space-y-2.5).

Paragraph-heavy section. Background #F8FAFC, border #F1F5F9. Text-size: 14px (sm), line-height: 1.5, max-width: 48rem (3xl). Each paragraph must have a 24px (indent-6) first-line indentation to mimic formal report typesetting.

3-column grid of cards. Each card has p-5 (20px) padding, border-radius 16px, and text-center alignment. Center card (Level/Rank) and Right card (Team) use neutral Slate-100 borders, while the primary recommendation card uses Blue-100 border and #EFF6FF background.

special_ui_components.description: A high-impact score display for the top-right of the report.
special_ui_components.prompt: A vertical-flex container, bg #2563EB, text #FFFFFF, padding 16px, rounded 16px (2xl). Top: 10px bold uppercase label 'OVERALL SCORE' at 80% opacity. Center: 36px font-black 'JetBrains Mono' score. Bottom: 10px score range 'OUT OF 5.0'.

special_ui_components.description: Primary floating interaction for report feedback or support.
special_ui_components.prompt: Fixed bottom-8 right-8. Size: 64x64px (w-16 h-16). Background #0F172A (Slate 900). 100% border radius. Shadow: 0 25px 50px -12px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.5). Icon: Lucide icon 24px size. Transition: hover scale-110.

structured.special_notes: MUST maintain the 960px max-width on the report to ensure PDF export scaling works correctly. DO NOT use heavy shadows on the report card during `@media print` (use border instead). MUST ensure all labels utilize the text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest style for that 'professional document' aesthetic. Paragraph indentation (indent-6) is mandatory for the Feedback section to maintain editorial quality.
